baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 1-3 form a transitive raising, a place noun, and a high adjective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The raising transfers the object from a prior locus; place supplies the destination, and high fixes its vertical relation.

activation_trace.role: Concrete lifting supplies upward transfer from one locus to another.
Place or position supplies the resulting destination.
Vertical elevation specifies the destination as above its prior level.

changed_reading.before: A nonspecific statement that he was raised.
changed_reading.after: A concrete relocation in which he is made to occupy an upper place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Each of the three focus roots independently permits rank or standing rather than geometry alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Honor-bearing raising acts on a place understood as standing, while high marks distinction of rank; the three terms mutually reinforce social or evaluative elevation.

activation_trace.role: Elevation of worth supplies promotion rather than bodily motion.
The place noun can function as position, standing, or degree.
Honor and nobility define the value-axis of the elevation.

changed_reading.before: He was moved to a high coordinate.
changed_reading.after: He was promoted into an exceptionally honored standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus raising verb at word 1 has a publicity branch, while words 2-3 support standing and honor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making a report manifest can raise a person by making his standing publicly and durably high, even without specifying a physical destination.

activation_trace.role: Making news manifest supplies public propagation as a mode of raising.
Standing supplies what is publicly elevated.
High honor supplies the public standing's quality.

changed_reading.before: The raising is private relocation or promotion.
changed_reading.after: The raising may also be the public elevation of his remembered standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate command to remember and register the focus figure, together with the earlier high truthful tongue, turns publicity into a coherent textual-social mechanism: he is durably placed high in transmitted memory.

activation_trace.role: Publicizing a report anchors remembered elevation in the focus verb.
Standing supplies the durable position produced by public memory.
Honor supplies the value carried by that remembered position.
Honorable reputation makes the command to remember a status-bearing act.
Entry into a register supplies durable textual placement.
Language and speech provide the medium in which elevated standing circulates.
The same high adjective already qualifies a truthful tongue, directly linking height to reputation.

structural_cues: 19:56 immediately introduces the focus figure through remembering and the book.
19:50 applies the same high adjective to a truthful tongue rather than to terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, registration, speech, and repeated high wording; I infer that transmission can perform the raising. Literal relocation remains a live coexisting alternative.

changed_reading.before: His high standing is asserted but its social medium is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: His standing is raised through durable inscription, truthful speech, and honorable remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby formulas join elevated ground, intimate counsel, favored nearness, presence before sovereignty, and approval. They recast a high place as an admitted station of access, not merely altitude.

activation_trace.role: Presentation or advancement before authority anchors the access model in the focus verb.
Standing or position supplies the admitted station.
High honor marks that station as privileged.
Favored nearness to a ruler supplies privileged access.
Elevated safe ground preserves a spatial image inside the relational formula.
Confidential discourse turns nearness into intimate access.
Presence with another supplies the relational location.
Sovereignty identifies the authority relative to whom standing matters.
Acceptance supplies the evaluative result of presence before that authority.

structural_cues: 19:52 and 19:57 share first-person-plural perfect verbs, object pronouns, and final indefinite descriptors.
19:55 places an approved person in a relation of presence with his Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical parallels and the spatial-relational branch pair; I infer that height can encode admitted proximity and approval. A geographic high place remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: The high place is a remote coordinate or abstract rank.
changed_reading.after: The high place is also a privileged station of nearness, audience, and approved presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gathers the focus figure into a blessed, prophetic, guided, and selected company. Place therefore gains a taxonomic and social function: elevation is bestowed placement within an elect lineage and role.

activation_trace.role: Promotion anchors the focus as bestowed rank.
Position or standing permits placement within a distinguished company.
Honor marks the company's placement as elevated.
Bestowed good condition frames the elevation as gift rather than self-attainment.
Prophetic office supplies the named company into which the focus figure is gathered.
Gentle direction toward the true way supplies directed inclusion.
Selection joined to drawing near supplies deliberate placement among the chosen.

structural_cues: The demonstrative opening of 19:58 immediately gathers the preceding named figures into one described class.
The focus figure's prophetic label in 19:56 is repeated as the class label in 19:58.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate grouping, blessing, guidance, and selection; I infer that the focus place can be corporate standing. The alternative is that 19:58 classifies persons without defining the place in 19:57.

changed_reading.before: The elevation is an isolated distinction granted only to the focus figure.
changed_reading.after: His high place also locates him within a guided, chosen, and blessed prophetic company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate move from divine raising to the chosen figures' falling, abasement, and weeping creates a vertical reversal: bestowed elevation manifests in voluntary lowering and is thereby distinguished from self-exalting domination.

activation_trace.role: Granted honor supplies the upward half of the reversal.
The root's domineering self-elevation branch supplies the nearby contrast that prostration checks.
Audible, forceful falling supplies the downward motion opposite raising.
Deliberate abasement turns descent into a posture of submission.
Tears and voiced grief make the lowering affective rather than merely geometric.

structural_cues: The high-place clause closes 19:57 and the explicit falling clause closes the immediately following 19:58.
The subject of the falling is the selected group into which 19:58 has just gathered the preceding figures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate opposite vertical motions and group continuity; I infer an ethical relation in which granted height elicits lowering. Mere narrative succession without causal force remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Elevation risks sounding like autonomous superiority.
changed_reading.after: The elevation is bestowed height whose fitting expression is prostrating descent, not self-exaltation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ت ل ل target for a recitation occurrence and converts textual sequence into topography. It remains packet-resolvable and anchored by the focus place/high construction plus book and recitation cues. Downstream prose should mark it as a lexical activation, never as the ordinary meaning of the context word or as a final interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2-3 provide high place, while the publicity branch of word 1 permits textual prominence.

activation_trace.role: Public propagation allows elevation to occur in transmitted discourse.
Place or standing supplies the textual position being raised.
Vertical height supplies the outlier's topographic image.
Written composition supplies the textual field in which prominence can occur.
One voice following another supplies recitational transmission.
The non-dominant mapped target contributes a raised mound as an exploratory textual-spatial image.

changed_reading.before: The high place lies outside the discourse that reports it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the book and its recitation themselves form the raised textual prominence on which the figure is placed.

strongest_changes: Altitude opens into durable textual and public standing through 19:50 and 19:56.
The parallels in 19:52 and 19:55 recast height as privileged presence and approval.
The immediate fall and prostration of 19:58 make bestowed height coexist with embodied lowering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly couples spatial vocabulary with status, speech, nearness, selection, and an immediate vertical reversal, so the focus supports several distinct mechanisms without requiring one final destination.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not force a choice between literal relocation, rank, memorial prominence, and privileged nearness.
The causal force of the 19:57-58 rise/fall juxtaposition is inferred rather than grammatically stated.
The textual-mound outlier depends on a non-dominant mapped root and must remain quarantined as exploratory.
